verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence describes performing one operation across many items at once, such as batch edits, multi-select actions, or bulk updates to apps or records. The task system (background tasks in isolated copies), scheduled routines, and the Replit MCP Server (create/find/update apps) cover parallel or scheduled agent work and per-app actions, not bulk operations. Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI app-building platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.
